decision: Primary analysis is restricted to app-based motorcycle work; car/taxi-online evidence is separate or contextual.
rationale: Motorcycle and car operating economics are structurally different and should not be pooled.
evidence_basis: Stage 0 research design and eligibility rules
analytical_implication: Vehicle-type comparisons require explicit separation.

decision: Customer-facing fare driver gross earnings driver receipts and net operating earnings must remain distinct concepts.
rationale: These amounts can differ because customer-side fees driver-side deductions incentives tips and operating costs occur at different layers.
evidence_basis: Stage 0 research design and measurement dictionary
analytical_implication: No source value may be relabelled across earnings layers without evidence.

decision: Tips and incentives are separated from core service earnings wherever evidence permits.
rationale: They may be conditional volatile or non-core and can materially affect apparent earnings.
evidence_basis: Stage 0 research design and measurement dictionary
analytical_implication: Core-earnings and total-receipts views may be reported separately.

decision: Household and personal consumption is excluded from driver operating costs.
rationale: Food housing household electricity schooling and other personal consumption do not arise from operating the driving activity itself.
evidence_basis: Stage 0 research design; Stage 1 IDEAS and Kompas source assessments
analytical_implication: Reported net figures that subtract personal food or household spending are not project net operating earnings unless components can be separated.

decision: Fuel or charging is an operating cost while fuel volume efficiency price and work-related distance are activity or input measures.
rationale: This preserves the distinction between observed expenditure and modelled cost.
evidence_basis: Stage 0 research design and rules R008-R011
analytical_implication: Observed fuel expenditure is preferred; modelled fuel requires explicit compatible inputs.

decision: Fuel-price inputs must be matched by fuel product effective date and geography where prices vary regionally.
rationale: Non-subsidized fuel prices can vary across regions and over time; a single national price can bias reconstructed cost.
evidence_basis: Stage 0 rules; Stage 1 fuel-price source assessment
analytical_implication: Reconstructed fuel costs and sensitivity analysis cannot use a national Pertamax price when regional prices differ.

decision: Total work-related distance is preferred for fuel vehicle-wear and net-per-km analysis; paid-trip distance alone is not treated as total operating distance.
rationale: Pickup repositioning and deadheading also consume fuel time and vehicle life.
evidence_basis: Stage 0 research design and rules R011/R016
analytical_implication: Paid-trip-only distance requires a caveat or may make total-cost metrics ineligible.

decision: Online hours productive or engaged hours and ambiguous source-reported working hours remain separate.
rationale: They measure different exposure and utilization concepts and can produce materially different hourly earnings.
evidence_basis: Stage 0 research design and rules R012-R014
analytical_implication: Net earnings per online hour and per productive hour are separate metrics and cannot be silently substituted.

decision: Vehicle economic-cost and cash-flow views are kept separate to avoid double counting depreciation financing principal interest and lease payments.
rationale: Capital consumption and financing cash flow are different accounting concepts.
evidence_basis: Stage 0 research design and rules R017-R021
analytical_implication: Depreciation plus financing principal is prohibited in the same economic-cost metric; depreciation is not added again to a lease/rental cash-flow view.

decision: Operative legal text official implementation statements platform-stated policies and realized driver deductions are separate evidence layers.
rationale: A rule or announcement does not establish what was actually deducted from a driver's transaction.
evidence_basis: Stage 0 research design; Stage 1 regulatory source registry
analytical_implication: No announced or stated fee rate is substituted for observed realized deduction.

decision: The referenced 2026 8% policy is not coded as a universal realized driver deduction and KP-PHB 532/2026 is not treated as authoritative legal text until the primary instrument is verified.
rationale: Current evidence establishes references and implementation statements but not a verified operative text with complete scope calculation base and legal relation to earlier instruments.
evidence_basis: Stage 1 SRC004-SRC008 and related assessments
analytical_implication: Any 2026 fee comparison must bind service date scope and evidence layer before interpretation.

decision: Customer payment minus driver receipt is labelled customer-to-driver gap and not platform commission unless the source proves the entire gap is a driver-side commission.
rationale: The gap may include customer-side service fees insurance promotions taxes or other components.
evidence_basis: Stage 0 rules R022-R024
analytical_implication: Commission-rate calculations require matched driver gross earnings and driver-side deduction evidence.

decision: Regulatory comparison follows legal text to effective date to service/scope to platform implementation to observed transaction to reconciliation status.
rationale: This prevents conclusions from mismatched regimes services or calculation bases.
evidence_basis: Stage 0 research design and rule R029; Stage 1 fee-source assessments
analytical_implication: Differences are initially classified as consistent with reference apparent difference requiring reconciliation not assessable or outside reference scope rather than legal compliance findings.

decision: Convenience purposive community or other non-probability driver samples are not treated as nationally representative.
rationale: Geographic breadth does not by itself create probability-based population inference.
evidence_basis: Stage 0 rule R043; Stage 1 INDEF IDEAS Fairwork and Polling Institute assessments
analytical_implication: Sample estimates are described at the sample or covered-population level unless representative design is documented.

decision: Secondary reports and mirrors may be used as corroboration or discovery evidence but quantitative use depends on verified definitions and provenance.
rationale: Secondary summaries can alter sample counts definitions periods or underlying source identity.
evidence_basis: Stage 1 Polling Institute Kompas IDEAS and BKT source assessment
analytical_implication: Quantitative ingestion is limited when the underlying source definition cannot be verified.

decision: Nominal IDR source values are preserved; inflation-adjusted values are derived only for defensible cross-period comparison using documented compatible CPI.
rationale: Overwriting nominal observations would destroy provenance and can hide the transformation basis.
evidence_basis: Stage 0 research design and rules R031-R033; Stage 1 BPS CPI sources
analytical_implication: Every real-value result retains original nominal value index geography reference period and formula.

decision: Affordability or purchasing-power context is analytically separate from driver unit economics.
rationale: Household expenditure poverty lines UMP/UMK and basic-needs indicators answer different questions from operating profitability.
evidence_basis: Stage 0 research design and rules R034-R037
analytical_implication: Context benchmarks are not subtracted as operating costs and do not by themselves establish legal underpayment or household welfare.

decision: Every analytical value is classified as observed source-reported derived modelled or scenario.
rationale: Findings need to distinguish evidence from transformations and assumptions.
evidence_basis: Stage 0 research design and rule R046
analytical_implication: Derived modelled and scenario values must retain traceable inputs and cannot masquerade as observations.

decision: Cross-source use is classified as directly comparable comparable with transformation comparable with caveat context only or not comparable.
rationale: Differences in concepts periods services vehicles denominators sampling and currency basis can invalidate pooling.
evidence_basis: Stage 0 research design and rules R038-R042
analytical_implication: Pooling is deferred until metric-level comparability is demonstrated; incompatibility is a valid result.

decision: Economic sustainability conclusions are not predetermined and should remain dimension-level unless multiple validated dimensions support a broader statement.
rationale: Unit economics alone cannot establish household welfare and different sustainability dimensions may disagree.
evidence_basis: Stage 0 research design and rule R050
analytical_implication: The final report must avoid a composite sustainability score or forced overall verdict without defensible evidence.

decision: Primary quantitative evidence is used only when its provenance definitions and relevant scope can be verified; otherwise its role is limited or excluded.
rationale: Lower-quality or incomplete evidence can distort unit-economics definitions and comparability.
evidence_basis: Stage 1 source assessment
analytical_implication: Unverified quantitative details are not inferred from secondary descriptions.

decision: Material methodological decisions retain their rationale evidence basis analytical implication and intended report destination.
rationale: Important analytical choices can materially affect interpretation and should remain traceable through synthesis.
evidence_basis: Stage 1 methodological governance
analytical_implication: Final reporting must reflect the methodological decisions that materially affect findings.

decision: A detailed study that cannot be verified is excluded from quantitative use; an authoritative downstream regulation may be assessed independently as regulatory evidence.
rationale: The existence of a supporting study does not establish its sample design metric definitions or numerical results.
evidence_basis: Stage 1 BKT/Kemenhub ATP-WTP assessment and KP 564/2022 review
analytical_implication: The BKT ATP/WTP detailed report is not used quantitatively while KP 564/2022 is treated separately as a historical legal source.
